name: Forliauken
backstory: Child of Forliauzco and Forliamuk, in Terfila; grew up around walks the transit route between Terfila and the..., and picked up a little of CONFLICT-01 along the way.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliauzco.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Forliarlo has died.
Heard that Tamuzco and Forliamuk now have a child, Tamuzaken.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Forliuzazco.
Had a child with Trezukar, named Forliaukar.
Heard that Forliamuk and Tamuzco now have a child, Tamuzmuken.
Heard that Tamuzco and Trezukar now have a child, Trezukuzco.
Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Tamuzakar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliazuzco.
Had a child with Farliukar, named Forliaukarla.
Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Trezukaken.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliukar now have a child, Forliaukarli.
Had a child with Tamuzukar, named Tamuzukauk.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Death Of Darnus is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Death Of Darnus actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: makes the walk between Terfila and the crossing when there's nothing better to do at the docks, and lingers by the temple a beat longer than the walk requires.

arc.premise: Forliauken wants to track down someone old enough to say plainly whether the temple's first stones really were sailors' work or masons' work, rather than let the transit-route version - whichever it happens to be that week - stand unquestioned.
